note: Custer Gallatin NF (Sioux Ranger District) campground in the North Cave Hills, 8 miles west and north of Ludlow, beside woods and a rocky, cliff-edged canyon; two group sites besides the family sites. No trash pickup. From US 85 two miles north of Ludlow: Tufte Road, then Forest Roads 3114 (Fuller Pass Road) and 3123. --Claude
